keyword: order high flow hydraulic sprayer 7 m3/h

title.en: The High-Flow Sprayer Order Is 11/15 kW and 7 m³/h
title.zh: 大流量喷涂机订单是 11/15 kW 和 7 m³/h

description.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the high-flow hydraulic sprayer at 11/15 kW, 7 m³/h, 8 MPa and 150 m / 70 m. The other hydraulic page is 7.5/9 kW and 5 m³/h.
description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把大流量液压喷涂机印成 11/15 kW、7 m³/h、8 MPa、150 m / 70 m。另一张液压页是 7.5/9 kW、5 m³/h。

h1.en: Choose the High-Flow Page When the Motors Are 11/15 kW
h1.zh: 电机是 11/15 kW 时选择大流量页

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the high-flow hydraulic concrete spraying machine at 380 V, 11/15 kW, dual motor, 7 m³/h, 8 MPa, 150 m / 70 m and hose 38/51 mm. Particle size on the selection note for this hydraulic family is ≤8 mm. The 5 m³/h hydraulic page prints 7.5/9 kW and 100 m / 50 m. A trailer pump is not either page. If the motors you can feed are 11/15 kW and the output cell you are matching is 7 m³/h, send [/en/products/high-flow-hydraulic-concrete-spraying-machine/](/en/products/high-flow-hydraulic-concrete-spraying-machine/) to [/en/contact/](/en/contact/). Quote only. No numeric price is printed.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械（邢台）把大流量液压混凝土喷涂机印成 380 V、11/15 kW、双电机、7 m³/h、8 MPa、150 m / 70 m、软管 38/51 mm。选型说明里这一液压系列的粒径是 ≤8 mm。5 m³/h 的液压页印 7.5/9 kW 和 100 m / 50 m。拖泵不是这两页中的任何一页。如果你能供给的电机是 11/15 kW，并且对照的输送量格是 7 m³/h，请把 [/zh/products/high-flow-hydraulic-concrete-spraying-machine/](/zh/products/high-flow-hydraulic-concrete-spraying-machine/) 发到 [/zh/contact/](/zh/contact/)。只询价。没有印数字价格。

body.en: Electric 15 prints 8–10 m³/h as a trailer. This 7 m³/h cell is a sprayer.
body.zh: 电动15作为拖泵印 8–10 m³/h。这个 7 m³/h 是喷涂机。

body.en: This sprayer page states 380 V. That still does not fill voltage on a trailer page.
body.zh: 这张喷涂页写明 380 V。这仍然不会填上拖泵页的电压。

body.en: 150 m / 70 m belongs to this page. The 5 m³/h page prints 100 m / 50 m.
body.zh: 150 m / 70 m 属于这一页。5 m³/h 那一页印 100 m / 50 m。

answer.en: No. 11/15 kW is the motor pair. Output is 7 m³/h.
answer.zh: 不是。11/15 kW 是电机一对。输送量是 7 m³/h。

question.zh: 粒径印成 ≤6 mm 了吗？

answer.en: The selection note for these hydraulic rows says ≤8 mm. The diesel concrete sprayer is the ≤6 mm page.
answer.zh: 这些液压行的选型说明写 ≤8 mm。≤6 mm 是柴油混凝土喷涂机那一页。

question.en: Do I also order the 5 m³/h page?
question.zh: 还要订 5 m³/h 那一页吗？

answer.en: Only if you are matching 7.5/9 kW and 5 m³/h. Otherwise send one path.
answer.zh: 只有你在对照 7.5/9 kW 和 5 m³/h 时才订。否则发送一条路径。

alt.zh: 大流量液压喷涂机，由河北品锦机械厂家制造，邢台
